title: upstream: OpenMLS ComponentType maps 0x8A8A+ to GREASE
description: Found in .4.44: OpenMLS random_grease_value picks from the 15 RFC 9420 GREASE values, but mls-extensions-10 §7.5 defines only 8 GREASE component IDs (0x0A0A-0x7A7A); 0x8A8A+ are component Private Use. mimi-mls now uses a §7.5-only generator for component GREASE. Check whether the OpenMLS fork uses random_grease_value for component IDs internally; if so, minimal repro and report upstream only with Mark's OK.
notes:
Upstream check 2026-10-17: the original suspicion is NOT A BUG — random_grease_value is only used in Capabilities::with_grease for RFC 9420 registries (ciphersuite, extension, proposal, credential types), where the 15 values are correct; OpenMLS never generates component-ID GREASE. Smaller related issue, NOT REPORTED: component.rs ComponentType has Grease8A8A..GreaseEAEA and From<ComponentId> maps 0x8A8A-0xEAEA to those instead of Private, contradicting mls-extensions-10 §7.5 (only 0x0A0A-0x7A7A are GREASE). Impact looks cosmetic (ComponentType only used to build named IDs; UnknownComponentId::new accepts IDs < 0x8000). mimi-mls's own §7.5 generator stays correct either way.
REPORTED 2026-10-17 by Mark (authorized): https://github.com/openmls/openmls/issues/2284 '[Bug] ComponentType classifies 0x8A8A-0xEAEA as GREASE; mls-extensions §7.5 makes them private use'.
